resources.string: One clipboard with the Mac: copy there, paste here.
Through your own server, encrypted on the devices.
The Mac shows a QR code
Scan it with the phone camera
Checking the token and exchanging keys
This is not a Tossling code
The QR code does not look like a pairing code. Run the command below on the Mac and scan the code from the terminal.
The server did not accept the token
The code is outdated or already used. Get a new one on the Mac and scan it again.
%1$s does not respond. Check the internet on the phone and that the server is running.
%1$s and this phone now share one clipboard
The phone is in one room at a time: it will leave the current one (%1$s) and stop sharing the clipboard with it.
This phone was in a room
The key stayed on this phone after Tossling was removed. Return as the same device, no QR code needed.
The room has moved on without this phone. Pair again with the QR code.
%1$s does not respond. Check the internet and try again.
The kept room could not be read. Pair again with the QR code.
